content.text:
**What I'd tell my friend:** Psagot Trade has no monthly account fee ("0.00 ₪ לחודש"). Each buy or sell costs "0.07%", at least "2.00 ₪" a time, and on top of that "0.03% לרבעון" just to hold what you bought. You need "10,000 ₪" to open the account, so my 30,000 is enough. I can buy קרן סל and קרן נאמנות there, both marked "אפשר". Foreign shares say "לא ידוע", so I don't know if I can buy American stuff directly. The ad says "פטור מלא מדמי ניהול ללא הגבלת זמן", but the page says "המסמך אומר אחרת" and shows "0.12% דמי משמרת". So "no management fees" isn't true, and that's what put me off. I'm not totally sure. I'd probably still look at the compare button before opening anything.

**How I went through it:**
- **Where I looked, in order:**
  - The heading "פסגות ניירות ערך (פסגות טרייד)". I know the name, so I stayed.
  - "העמלות": I read the big numbers 0.07%, 2.00 ₪, 0.03%, the two currency lines (1.5 agorot and 0.5%) and 0.00 ₪.
  - "מה אפשר לקנות כאן": the green "אפשר" labels and the orange "לא ידוע".
  - "מה כתוב בפרסום, ומה במסמכים": just the orange "המסמך אומר אחרת" tags and the quotes in big text.
  - The 10,000 ₪ minimum and the two buttons at the bottom.
- **What I skipped:**
  - The long grey paragraph under "ניירות ערך זרים".
  - The source links and dates.
  - The "מה מגן על הכסף" fold.
  - "חשבון ניירות ערך · 2" at the bottom.
  - The footer.
- **Where I got stuck:**
  - There are two "המרת מטבע" lines, one "1.5 אגורות לדולר" and one "0.5%". Which one do I actually pay? No idea.
  - I don't get how "0.03% לרבעון" and "0.12% דמי משמרת" fit together. Are they the same fee or two separate ones?
  - Foreign shares say "לא ידוע". Does that mean I can't get the S&P there? I guessed a קרן סל probably covers it, but I'm not sure.
- **Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "מק"מ", "נאמן"/"קרן נאמנות" (sort of), "ני"ע", "מרווח ההמרה".
- **Would I have left?** Nearly, at the ad-versus-documents part. When the ad and the documents disagree three times, I stop trusting the ad.
